description: Java class 'OfficeSheetPopulator' that populates an Excel sheet with office data, including setting up the layout, writing office IDs and names, and protecting the sheet.

classes.name: OfficeSheetPopulator
classes.description: A class that populates an Excel sheet with office data, configuring layout and filling in office details.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Creates the sheet, sets layout, populates offices, and protects the sheet.

methods.name: populateOffices
methods.description: Fills in office data rows starting from a given index.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Sets up column widths and header row for the sheet.

methods.name: getOffices
methods.description: Returns the list of OfficeData objects.

methods.name: getOfficeNames
methods.description: Returns a list of office names extracted from the OfficeData objects.
